tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Smithsonian Institution to carry out this subchapter, other than sections 80r–5(b) and 80r–6 of this title—

children.text: such sums as are necessary for each fiscal year thereafter.

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Amounts made available under subsection (a) shall remain available until expended.

tree.heading: Use of funds for fundraising
tree.text: Amounts appropriated pursuant to the authorization under this section may be used to conduct fundraising in support of the Museum from private sources.
